ILLIQ-AMIHUD-28D-W.verbatim_quote: generic adapter fees/slippage; native funding while held; stress = fee x1.5, +2 ticks, +1 event delay

verbatim_quotes: fills at the close of the first completed 15m bar strictly after the decision stamp (Monday 00:15:00Z close); stress +1 event delay fills at the Monday 00:30:00Z close

lineage_cost.role: diagnostic continuity ledger only; CURRENT_CONSERVATIVE_COST is the primary shadow reality check (plan section 6)

taker_fee.tier_basis: declared conservative regular-user (VIP0-equivalent) USDT-margined futures tier
taker_fee.fallback_rationale: public fee-schedule pages are UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED in this environment (see data_manifest.unavailable_evidence unavail-001..003); per dispatch, the most conservative documented tier is used: 0.05% taker / 0.02% maker, which errs pessimistic if a cheaper tier applies

tick_size_roles.family1_family2: universes NOT enumerated in the identity manifest; tick sizes for their PIT-eligible sets are resolved at decision time from the same archived exchangeInfo bytes (values are verbatim strings as published)

slippage_model.model: frozen fixed slippage: 1 tick per virtual fill, adverse direction
slippage_model.reference_price: the fill bar's price (close of the first completed 15m bar strictly after the decision)
slippage_model.fill_price_rule: long: fill_bar_close + 1 tick; short: fill_bar_close - 1 tick

funding_settlement_convention.booking: each settlement booked ONCE while held, with rule ts_opened <= fundingTime < ts_closed
funding_settlement_convention.sign_convention: positive rate: long pays, short receives; negative rate inverted (short pays, long receives)
funding_settlement_convention.source: settled rates only, from keyless GET https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingRate

latency_assumption.rule: virtual fill at the first completed 15-minute bar strictly after the decision timestamp

immutability.venue_fee_change_protocol: a genuine venue fee change creates a dated cost-regime boundary and a NEW frozen cost_regime hash; never an in-place rewrite of this block

cost_regime_digest_canonicalization: sha256 over UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(current_conservative_cost, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)
